answer: Vesting with clawback resists sybils: influence an identity earns is not spendable at once; it vests linearly over a fixed window of honest epochs, and any still-unvested weight is clawed back if that identity is later caught cheating. A farm cannot bank standing, sign it away with one quick quill-stroke, and walk; the unvested remainder stays hollow until time passes. The velvet of full weight is earned only by surviving the whole vesting window honestly, so fast disposable fakes never reach their rated power.
